name: sohbeto-pc-agent
description: Sohbeto PC Ajanı — telefondan bilgisayara P2P köprü (dosya al/gönder, WoL)

scripts.pack:win: npm run prepare:native && npx pkg . --targets node18-win-x64 --output dist/sohbeto-pc-agent.exe
scripts.pack:linux: npm run prepare:native && npx pkg . --targets node18-linux-x64 --output dist/sohbeto-pc-agent
scripts.pack:mac: npm run prepare:native && npx pkg . --targets node18-macos-x64 --output dist/sohbeto-pc-agent
